title: Azure Functions Python DX Toolkit — endpoint metadata namespace (schema version 1)
description: Vendored, self-contained contract for the payload stored at handler._azure_functions_metadata['endpoint']. Producers (azure-functions-langgraph, azure-functions-validation) emit this; consumers (azure-functions-openapi) and validators (azure-functions-doctor) read it — WITHOUT importing any shared runtime package. This file is vendored intentionally (issue #368): the toolkit deliberately shares this convention by copy, not by a runtime dependency, so five packages keep independent release cadences. Keep it byte-consistent with the sibling copies.

version.description: Schema version of this endpoint payload.

request_body.description: Request body JSON Schema (validation mode), or null when the route has no request body.

request_body_required.description: Whether the request body is required.

parameters.description: OpenAPI parameter objects (path/query/header). Each entry is self-contained.

responses.description: Map of HTTP status code (string) to a response object carrying a 'schema' (serialization mode), or null when the route emits no single JSON response (e.g. SSE streams).
